product_one_liner.value: Obsidian provides enterprise security teams real-time visibility, governance, and enforcement across AI agents, identities, and integrations in their third-party SaaS applications.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is marketing-oriented, and the reviewed archive yielded only one clearly engineer-coauthored product-build post.

public_docs.notes: The documentation endpoint requires access from inside the Obsidian portal and does not expose public articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists AI Security Engineer and Agent Security Research Engineer roles.

model_provider.notes: The public AI Assistant FAQ and reviewed trust/subprocessor materials did not identify a model provider used by the product.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series D was announced August 4, 2026, within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board lists several Enterprise Account Executive openings.

launched_6mo.notes: Obsidian announced its Claude Compliance API integration on July 21, 2026, within the six-month window ending November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small executive leadership roster contains no dated C-level or VP-level join in the window; no in-window C-level or VP departure was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The posting says reporting is pulled from call-intelligence (Gong) and CRM tools; it does not name the CRM.
